modifications: Isolated package name xenium_runtime; original prototype unchanged.
No legacy LUAD atlas builder, reference rulebook or specimen calibration.
UCell observation names changed to AUCell, using within-type and detection-depth percentiles.
Macrophage is a provisional generic class; SPP1 subtype was not observed.
No network transport or credential handling; local policies only.
Missing score evidence is not imputed to a midpoint.
Contract population cap is 1000; initial proliferating tumour assignment disabled.
The offline cycle rule uses a declared 0.75 within-type/depth percentile and requires a positive raw AUCell score; this threshold is not biologically calibrated.
Constant depth-reference signatures remain unavailable; annotation edits invalidate derived scores and selections.
